item.title: Percussionaire Corporation: Intrapulmonary Percussive Ventilation, IPV HC, Product Number: S00009; Phasitron, P5-HC Recall
item.product: Intrapulmonary Percussive Ventilation, IPV HC, Product Number: S00009; Phasitron, P5-HC
item.summary: Labeling updated warning not to use Intrapulmonary percussive ventilation (IPV) in conjunction with volatile anesthetic delivery systems because IPV may alter controlled delivery of volatile anesthetic agents, resulting in deeper/lighter anesthetic effects that may result in hypertonia/hypotonia, tachycardia/ bradycardia, elevated intracranial pressure, awareness during anesthesia, oversedation Product details: Intrapulmonary Percussive Ventilation, IPV HC, Product Number: S00009; Phasitron, P5-HC
